description: Definition of a US legal term or doctrine from Cornell LII's Wex legal encyclopedia: the plain-English explanation, its related Wex terms, topic categories and last-reviewed date. Answers "what does habeas corpus mean", "define adverse possession", "explain res judicata". Free: LII licenses Wex CC BY-NC-SA, so this call costs 0 credits and the response carries the attribution and licence a caller must pass on.

term.description: The legal term as written, e.g. "tort", "adverse possession", "res judicata", "Miranda warning". Case and spaces do not matter.
